label: sparse, diffuse: weakly enriched for input 0 in copy phase / sequences containing f
explanation: Very sparse (0.09% of steps), mid-to-late steps (never t<3, rarely in last-to-go>5 region), split across original (42% mass) and copy (56%) phases. Strongest token enrichments: input 0 (11.5x lift, 36% of mass), input f (5.7x), output/next output f (11x), first token f (8.5x), but each covers a small fraction of steps where it holds: copy-phase input 0 has precision ~2%; adding in_orig(f) raises precision only to ~7% at 21% recall (dev F1 0.10). Activations also occur on arbitrary letters with no shared context. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.27) and no tested condition separated high from low activations. The feature appears to depend on a joint hidden-state configuration not captured by simple token/position predicates.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=11: 0, f, w, p; t=17: 0, f, a, p; t=10: 0, f, w, p) and the token being output (most: f, a, n, d, u, c; least: l, m, 3, g); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=4, L=7 & t=6, t=4.
